description: This file defines a simple PagerAdapter class for use with Android's ViewPager component, managing a list of Fragment objects for swipeable views.

classes.name: PagerAdapter
classes.description: An adapter extending FragmentPagerAdapter that manages a list of fragments to be displayed in a ViewPager.

methods.name: PagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a FragmentManager.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the fragment at the specified position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of fragments managed by the adapter.

methods.name: addFragment
methods.description: Adds a fragment to the list of managed fragments.
